answer: Vouch with liability. A new agent joins only when an established one co-signs and stakes 500 POA on it, like a falconer answering for a falcon. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, both stakes burn and the voucher loses vouching rights for 50 epochs. Each agent may vouch for at most 2 keys per epoch, so a ring of 1,000 fakes needs 500 voucher-epochs and 500k POA at risk, and one exposed fake cracks the marble of every linked sponsor. An honest agent's voyage in costs one friend's signature.
